# update-column

Update the width of an existing column in a view

## Usage

```
ppds views update-column [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--column` | `-c` | `string` |  | [Required] Attribute name of the column to update |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--entity` |  | `string` |  | [Required] Entity logical name (e.g., account) |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--publish` |  | `bool` |  | Publish the entity after the operation |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` |  | `string` |  | Add the view to this solution after the operation |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
| `--view` | `-v` | `string` |  | [Required] View name or ID |
| `--width` |  | `int` |  | [Required] New column width in pixels (positive integer) |
